definitions.gloss: to climb, to go up, to ascend
definitions.explanation: Used for climbing mountains, hills, stairs, or any upward movement. Takes the particle を to mark what is being climbed, or に for the destination.

examples.japanese: {階段|かいだん}を{登|のぼ}ってください。
{富士山|ふじさん}に{登|のぼ}りたいです。
examples.english: I want to climb Mt. Fuji.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xに/を{登|のぼ}る (climb X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {登|のぼ}っている = 'is climbing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{山|やま}に{登|のぼ}る (climb a mountain)
・{階段|かいだん}を{登|のぼ}る (go up stairs)
・{富士山|ふじさん}に{登|のぼ}る (climb Mt. Fuji)
・{木|き}に{登|のぼ}る (climb a tree)

Kanji 登 means 'climb/ascend'. For general upward motion, {上|あ}がる is also used. Opposite: {下|お}りる (go down).
